title: The Base-Rate Effect on LLM Benchmark Performance: Disambiguating Test-Taking Strategies from Benchmark Performance

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the base-rate probability (BRP) of answer tokens (A, B, C, D) using cloze and counterfactual prompting, and evaluating model performance on a modified MMLU dataset (Nvr-X-MMLU) where correct answer labels are systematically reassigned to isolate token preference.
